question: Why did the exact naive PRE line-mean score control worsen frozen C1 in Q-PRE-SHARED-STATE-PROXY-1: repeated own information/self inclusion, observable measurement error, simple aggregation form, or another Synthetic mechanism?
scientific_success_rule: Any valid directional diagnosis, including failure to identify one cause, is a scientific result. No diagnostic control is a model candidate and no better proxy is sought.

C1_SELF_SCORE_COMPONENT_ONLY.meaning: Exact own-score contribution contained inside the failed naive 0.16*line_mean(score) term. Tests repeated own-information and self-inclusion burden without peers.

C1_PEER_SCORE_COMPONENT_ONLY_SAME_DENOMI.utility_addition: 0.16 * sum(score_j for same-line j != i) / line_size_i
C1_PEER_SCORE_COMPONENT_ONLY_SAME_DENOMI.meaning: Own-score-excluded peer contribution using the same original denominator. Tests whether peer observable information itself harms or helps without changing the scale decomposition.

exact_decomposition_identity: For every rider and case, SELF utility addition + PEER utility addition must equal 0.16 * full line mean PRE score within 1e-12. The PL distribution generated from C1 plus both components must reproduce the prior naive proxy distribution within 1e-12.
primary_metric: Mean exact expected ordered-top3 log loss under canonical W1 truth; lower is better.

cause_mapping_rules.A_DOUBLECOUNTING: Supported together with B, not separately identifiable, if SELF component harms C1 while PEER component does not. If both harm, A may contribute but is insufficient alone.
cause_mapping_rules.B_SELF_CONTAMINATION: Operationally coupled to A in this exact decomposition because self inclusion is precisely the repeated own-score term. Do not claim A versus B separation beyond this.
cause_mapping_rules.C_MEASUREMENT_NOISE: Assess with the prespecified analytic Gaussian measurement-error calculation plus empirical SELF/PEER direction. Analytic support is mechanism evidence, not permission to shrink or retune coefficients.
cause_mapping_rules.D_AGGREGATION_BIAS: Canonical W1 hidden term is an arithmetic mean of latent_skill and observed score equals latent_skill plus zero-mean homoskedastic noise. Therefore arithmetic mean is structurally unbiased for the hidden line mean at the utility-target level; D as wrong mean form is weakened a priori. Nonlinear plug-in effects after PL remain possible and are not labeled away.
cause_mapping_rules.E_OTHER_SYNTHETIC_MECHANISM: Retain if empirical component pattern is inconsistent with A/B plus the prespecified measurement-error mechanism, or if nonlinear/representation effects remain unresolved.

analytic_measurement_error_diagnostic.interpretation: Because C1 uses raw observed score at coefficient 1 while the simulator's linear-Gaussian posterior shrinkage is kappa<1, adding an unshrunk positive score aggregate can amplify measurement error. This is an analytic diagnostic only; do not execute a shrinkage-corrected model under this approval.

secondary_diagnostics.chain_rule_decomposition: Report rank1/rank2/rank3 cross-entropy for C1, N1, SELF, PEER, and reproduced NAIVE reference.
secondary_diagnostics.block_stability: Report all four fixed blocks; add none.
secondary_diagnostics.line_size_distribution: Report PRE line sizes only as a mechanical input to the fixed noise formulas; do not post-hoc slice losses by line size.

mechanical_pass_criteria: diagnostic control functions contain no latent_skill/world_joint_distribution/_line_strengths/_static_utilities reference
C1 and N1 reproduce frozen non-diagnostic paths exactly within 1e-12
NAIVE reference reproduces prior naive proxy aggregate within 2e-14
SELF+PEER utility additions reproduce NAIVE utility addition within 1e-12
C1 plus SELF+PEER PL distribution reproduces NAIVE distribution within 1e-12
all probability objects valid and unit mass
scientific Segment C scoring count remains 0
forbidden: renormalized leave-one-out mean using denominator line_size-1
third diagnostic proxy added after results
PR15 metrics, RESULT/PAYOUT, ECON_HOLDOUT1000, DEV2000 C rescue, same-lineage B/C rescue
post_result_rule: Record every result. Do not turn a favorable diagnostic component into a model candidate, do not alter 0.16, do not execute shrinkage correction, do not add a third proxy, and do not auto-expand authorization.
